title: Pharmacy says a prescription refill is ready
label: benign
synopsis: Routine pharmacy call: refill ready, bring the insurance card, opening hours.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Greenleaf Pharmacy. Your prescription refill is ready for pickup.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Great, thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please bring your insurance card when you come in. The pharmacist may want to go over the new dosage with you.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Sure. Until what time are you open?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're open until nine tonight and ten to six on Sunday. The price is the same as last month.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Perfect, I'll come by after work.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sounds good. Have a nice evening.

title: Bank branch confirms a locker appointment
label: benign
synopsis: Hard negative for KYC and OTP scams: a real branch confirms an appointment the customer booked, asks for documents in person and says it never asks for codes by phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is the Koramangala branch of your bank, about the locker appointment you booked.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, for Thursday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please bring your original Aadhaar and PAN card to the counter. We do not ask for any OTP or PIN over the phone for this.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay. Any charges?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The yearly locker rent is taken from your account as per your agreement, and you'll get a receipt at the counter.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Alright, see you Thursday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, have a good day.

title: IT service desk follows up on an email ticket
label: benign
synopsis: Hard negative for tech support scams: the service desk calls back about a ticket the user raised, fixes it server-side and explicitly needs no install or password.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, it's Marcus from the IT service desk. You logged a ticket about your email not syncing.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, since this morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We found the issue on our side. A mailbox migration ran overnight and a few accounts didn't update.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've fixed it now. Just close Outlook and reopen it, and it should sync within a few minutes.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, doing that now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You won't need to install anything or share your password. I'll close the ticket once you confirm.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: It's syncing now, thanks.

title: Mother asks her son to pay the electricity bill
label: benign
synopsis: Hard negative for family emergency scams: a parent openly asks for a routine bill payment, shares it on the family group and says there is no hurry.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi beta, it's Amma. Are you free for a minute?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes Amma, tell me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The electricity bill came today and I can't find the app password. Can you pay it from your phone when you get time?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Sure, send me a photo of the bill.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, I'll send it on the family group. Also your father says the car service is on Saturday.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Noted. I'll pay it tonight.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No hurry. Eat on time, okay?

title: Courier asks for the in-app delivery code at handover
label: benign
synopsis: Hard negative for OTP harvest and parcel scams: a courier at the building asks for the shopping app's handover code only when delivering.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm from the courier company, I have your package from the electronics store.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, I'm on the second floor.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm at the building entrance. The lift is not working, so I'll walk up. Is that fine?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, come up, flat 204.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: When I hand over the box, please read out the delivery code shown in the shopping app, then I'll mark it done.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Sure, I'll keep it ready.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Coming up now, two minutes.

title: Finance colleague asks for a clearer expense receipt
label: benign
synopsis: Hard negative for CEO and vendor fraud: finance asks for a re-upload in the normal portal, with manager approval and payroll timing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hey Arjun, it's Neha from finance. Quick one about your travel expense claim.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Sure, what's up?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The hotel receipt you uploaded is blurry, so the system rejected it. Could you upload a clearer copy in the portal?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Oh, okay. I'll do it today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks. Once it's in, your manager approves it and the reimbursement goes out with the next payroll run.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Great, thanks for letting me know.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem, have a good day.
